newsHighlights.title: First look: 2026 WIC Wuzhen Summit
newsHighlights.summary: The 2026 World Internet Conference Wuzhen Summit is set to gather global tech leaders to discuss artificial intelligence, digital economy and internet governance.
newsHighlights.translation: 2026年世界互联网大会乌镇峰会将汇聚全球科技领袖，共同探讨人工智能、数字经济与互联网治理议题。

newsHighlights.title: Jan-Sept growth driven by opening-up
newsHighlights.summary: China's continued economic growth and further opening-up are reinforcing foreign companies' confidence, encouraging them to expand manufacturing and research activities in high-tech sectors.
newsHighlights.translation: 中国经济持续增长与进一步对外开放增强了外资企业的信心，促使它们扩大在高技术领域的制造与研发活动。

newsHighlights.title: World Bank director sees China's buzzwords
newsHighlights.summary: A World Bank director noted that China's development buzzwords, from new quality productive forces to digital transformation, are shaping the global growth agenda.
newsHighlights.translation: 世界银行一位官员指出，从新质生产力到数字化转型，中国的发展热词正在塑造全球增长议程。

newsHighlights.title: Tianjin's old industrial heart beats with new life
newsHighlights.summary: Traditional factories in Tianjin are being upgraded with smart manufacturing and digital technologies, turning old industrial districts into hubs of innovation.
newsHighlights.translation: 天津的传统工厂正通过智能制造和数字技术进行升级，使老工业区转变为创新中心。

quote.quote: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
quote.author: Alan Kay
quote.translation: 预测未来最好的方式就是创造未来。
quote.explanation: 这句名言强调创新的主动性：与其被动等待未来，不如通过科技研发去塑造未来。这与世界互联网大会倡导的自主创新、人工智能前沿探索精神高度契合。

vocabulary.example: The 2026 Wuzhen Summit will focus on artificial intelligence and digital governance.
vocabulary.translation: 2026年乌镇峰会将聚焦人工智能与数字治理。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题 "First look: 2026 WIC Wuzhen Summit"，指世界互联网大会乌镇峰会。

vocabulary.example: Technological innovation is the main engine of China's high-quality growth.
vocabulary.translation: 科技创新是推动中国高质量增长的主引擎。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 Tianjin's old industrial heart beats with new life，老工业区依靠创新焕发生机。

vocabulary.example: Digital transformation is reshaping every industry in the country.
vocabulary.translation: 数字化转型正在重塑该国的每一个行业。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 World Bank director sees China's buzzwords，digital transformation 是其中的核心热词。

vocabulary.example: Thousands of delegates from around the world will attend the Wuzhen Summit.
vocabulary.translation: 来自世界各地的数千名代表将出席乌镇峰会。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 2026 WIC Wuzhen Summit 报道，指参会的各国政商与科技界代表。

vocabulary.example: Recent breakthroughs in AI models have attracted global attention.
vocabulary.translation: 人工智能模型的最新突破引起了全球关注。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 Wuzhen Summit 相关报道，峰会议题涵盖人工智能领域的关键技术突破。

vocabulary.example: China is speeding up the construction of digital infrastructure such as data centers.
vocabulary.translation: 中国正在加快数据中心等数字基础设施的建设。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 Getting water where it's needed 与峰会报道，基础设施建设是科技落地的重要支撑。

vocabulary.example: The summit promotes the sustainable development of the digital economy.
vocabulary.translation: 峰会倡导数字经济的可持续发展。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 China rising as leader in clean governance 及峰会主题，强调绿色发展与可持续治理。

vocabulary.example: The deep integration of AI and manufacturing is boosting productivity.
vocabulary.translation: 人工智能与制造业的深度融合正在提升生产效率。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 Tianjin's old industrial heart beats with new life，智能技术与传统工业加速融合。

vocabulary.example: Scientists discussed frontier technologies at the Wuzhen Summit.
vocabulary.translation: 科学家们在乌镇峰会上探讨了前沿技术。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 2026 WIC Wuzhen Summit 报道，会议聚焦人工智能等前沿科技方向。

vocabulary.example: Global AI governance requires cooperation among all countries.
vocabulary.translation: 全球人工智能治理需要各国合作。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自 China rising as leader in clean governance 及峰会关于互联网治理的议题。

pattern.pattern: Sth/Sb + be expected to + 动词原形（预计会……；有望……）
pattern.example: The 2026 WIC Wuzhen Summit is expected to attract delegates and tech leaders from around the world.
pattern.translation: 2026年世界互联网大会乌镇峰会预计将迎来世界各地的代表和科技领袖。
pattern.usage: 用于表达基于现状的合理预测或官方预期，语气比 will 更委婉客观。常见于新闻报道与商业写作，如：The policy is expected to boost investment in AI research.

grammar.title: 过去分词作后置定语（Past Participle as Post-positive Modifier）
grammar.explanation: 过去分词（done）放在名词后面作定语，相当于一个省略的定语从句，表示被动或已完成的动作。结构为：名词 + 过去分词短语。例如 growth driven by opening-up = growth which is driven by opening-up。这种结构在新闻英语中极为常见，可使句子更简洁紧凑。
examples: Jan-Sept growth driven by opening-up has strengthened foreign companies' confidence.
The technologies developed by Chinese firms are being discussed at the Wuzhen Summit.

pronunciation.tips: 该词有四个音节，重音落在第三个音节 va /veɪ/ 上，读作 in-nə-VAY-shn。前两个音节 /ˌɪnə/ 要读得轻而快，几乎一带而过；结尾的 -tion 发 /ʃn/，不要读成 /tiən/。注意与动词 innovate /ˈɪnəveɪt/ 的重音不同。
examples: Innovation is the theme of this year's Wuzhen Summit.
China's innovation-driven development has drawn worldwide attention.

reading.title: Wuzhen Summit Puts AI in the Spotlight
reading.content:
The historic water town of Wuzhen in Zhejiang province is once again preparing to host the World Internet Conference Wuzhen Summit. This year's event is expected to attract delegates, scientists and business leaders from around the globe.

Artificial intelligence sits at the heart of the agenda. Experts will discuss frontier technologies, digital infrastructure and global AI governance. Organizers say the summit aims to make digital development more open, inclusive and sustainable.

At the same time, China's high-tech growth is drawing foreign investment. Companies are expanding both manufacturing and research activities in the country, encouraged by policies that support innovation. Tianjin's old industrial districts, for example, are being transformed into smart manufacturing hubs.

As digital transformation accelerates, Wuzhen offers a window into how technology can serve people, drive the economy and shape a shared future.
reading.translation:
浙江的历史水乡乌镇正在筹备再次举办世界互联网大会乌镇峰会。今年的活动预计将迎来全球各地的代表、科学家和企业领袖。

人工智能是本届议程的核心。专家们将讨论前沿技术、数字基础设施以及全球人工智能治理。主办方表示，峰会旨在推动数字化发展更加开放、包容、可持续。

与此同时，中国的高技术增长正吸引外资。在支持创新的政策鼓励下，企业纷纷扩大在华的制造与研发活动。例如，天津的老工业区正在被改造为智能制造中心。

随着数字化转型加速，乌镇为人们展示了技术如何服务人类、驱动经济并塑造共同未来。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 China Daily《First look: 2026 WIC Wuzhen Summit》《Jan-Sept growth driven by opening-up》《Tianjin's old industrial heart beats with new life》等真实新闻素材改写，用于英语学习目的。
